source: direct homeowner instruction in current conversation
instruction: 之后的所有内容不考虑预算，只考虑设计
supersedes: previous RMB 100000 public-area hard-finish budget and its allocation targets as constraints on subsequent design
design_priorities: flush doors and walls, narrow finishes, lines and local curves
implementation: Do not select, downgrade, omit or rank design options by cost, and do not proactively produce estimates, budget allocations or value-for-money comparisons. Retain prior confirmed style and function. Preserve measured and provisional dimensional distinctions.
historical_budget_records: preserved as version history; no longer active design constraints

render_delivery.source_instruction: 之后整体出餐厅、客厅、阳台、门厅的实景渲染图
render_delivery.applies_to: all subsequent design updates and render deliveries in this project
render_delivery.delivery: Provide one coordinated photorealistic concept render set covering all four areas, rather than only the locally edited area.
render_delivery.consistency: Use the same current master model and latest user placements; coordinate style, colors, materials and lighting across all views.
render_delivery.views: Include an overall view of each area; add detail or day/evening views when useful for the current design change.

panorama_delivery.source_instruction: 把餐厅、门厅、客厅、阳台制作成可以360度全方位观察的VR影像
panorama_delivery.viewer: offline browser, mouse/touch/keyboard; fixed nodes, no 6DOF or stereo claim
